## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the save command before merge because callers rely on its success signal to know whether a report is available.

## Changes
The pull request adds a function that writes the generated report and announces its destination, plus a cleanup function that tolerates an already absent temporary report.

## Critical
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report write failures to the caller — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` prints “Report saved” and returns `0`. The `except OSError` block discards the write error before execution continues to the success message. — Users who specify a missing destination directory can proceed expecting a report that was never created. — Fix: Emit the destination and OS error, return a nonzero status, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
